rule: Apply 0.36 EUR/kWh only to Repsol Spain EVSEs positively identified as normal car charging, and 0.56 EUR/kWh only to EVSEs positively identified as ultra-fast car charging. Do not apply the published fast-charge value because Repsol states it as 'from 0.48 EUR/kWh', not an exact universal tariff. Repsol-partner/roaming points and any EVSE whose charge class or operator ownership cannot be positively established remain fail-closed/unpriced until an exact tariff is obtained.
